blocks.text: Get your tap water closer to pure and enjoy the drinking and plumbing benefits of a water softening system in San Antonio, TX. Effects of minerals in your water in these quantities can be unpleasant, damaging plumbing and appliances.

For a deeper cleaning of your home’s water supply beyond hard water problems, a water filtration system can remove natural and industrial contaminants. Targeting your filtration system using the results of water quality testing and your family’s desire for clean drinking water, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air can change the way you feel about your water at home.
If I Drink Bottled Water Anyway, Why Choose Filtration?

The realities of bottled water include the number of plastic bottles of water purchased, transported, and used by each person yearly. Water filtration systems produce high-quality water from every faucet, even the shower and laundry. It can help with hydration to have great water handy, and with reduced mineral content, your water is better for your plumbing and appliances. You can choose the level of filtration in your home, all the way to reverse osmosis (RO), the gold standard.
